description: BUG 2 — Pashto/Sindhi regional-script item names and number words not recognized; plus the Punjabi tea alias and the two missing Punjabi number words. Add a conservative Arabic->Urdu script-variant normalization and the missing aliases to awaaz_backend/rate-list.json so Pashto/Sindhi staples resolve, add Pashto number words (and Punjabi تن=3, پنجاہ=50) to awaaz_backend/services/nlp_rules.py, and add the Punjabi چاہ پتی alias to the EXISTING chai_patti item (do NOT create a new tea item; keep its SAMPLE price). Must NOT reintroduce loose substring matching (keep find_all_items word-boundary discipline so the 7-item no-Chicken invariant holds). Depends on FEAT-001's segmentation to make the Pashto/Punjabi end-to-end examples fully pass; implement after FEAT-001.
steps: In awaaz_backend/services/rates.py add a private _normalize_script(s) that folds common Arabic variants to the Urdu forms the rate-list uses: Arabic yeh ي (U+064A) -> Urdu yeh ی (U+06CC); alef-maksura ى (U+0649) -> ی; Arabic kaf ك (U+0643) -> Urdu kaf ک (U+06A9). Do NOT fold heh variants (collision risk) — add a '# NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED: heh variants intentionally not folded' comment. Apply _normalize_script when building _alias_map keys in load() AND to the query text inside find_all_items and resolve_item normalization, so پياز (Arabic yeh) matches rate-list پیاز (Urdu yeh). Keep the word-boundary regex; this is additive, not a widening to substrings.

In awaaz_backend/rate-list.json extend aliases arrays (valid UTF-8 JSON). Each non-English/Urdu spelling MUST be covered by a nearby NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED note where uncertain. aloo: add الو, آلو. pyaaz: add پياز (Arabic-yeh Pashto), بصر (Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED). tamatar: add رومي (Pashto), ٽماٽا, ٽماٽو (Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED). chini: add بوره (Pashto), کنڊ, چيني (Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED). chicken_meat: add چرګ, مرغ (Pashto), ڪڪڙ (Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED) — keep whole-word. anday: add هګۍ (Pashto), آنا, بيضا (Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED). banaspati_ghee: add غوړي (Pashto), گيهه (Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED). atta_kg: add اٽو (Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED). chai_patti: add چاہ پتی (Punjabi Shahmukhi) and چاې (Pashto, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED); do NOT change its price (SAMPLE 1600). Since rate-list.json has no code comments, record the NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED markers in this FEAT's findings and in the plan rather than in the JSON.

In awaaz_backend/services/nlp_rules.py BASIC_NUMBER_WORDS add Pashto words: يو=1, دوه=2, درې=3, څلور=4, پنځه=5, شپږ=6, اووه=7, اته=8, نهه=9, لس=10, شل=20, پنځوس=50, سل=100, سوه=100, زر=1000, زره=1000; and the missing Punjabi تن=3, پنجاہ=50. Add a '# NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED' comment on the Pashto/Sindhi block. In parse_word_numbers compound_hundreds prefix list add the Pashto 1-9 prefixes (يو,دوه,درې,څلور,پنځه,شپږ,اووه,اته,نهه); add سل and سوه to the hundred-word list and زر/زره to the thousand-word list so 'يو سل پنځوس'=150 and 'دوه سوه'=200 parse. Keep additions high-precision; review سل/زر for collisions with commodity tokens.

Add BUG-2 regression tests. In awaaz_backend/tests/test_rates.py add test_find_all_items_resolves_pashto_sindhi_staples: find_all_items('الو') contains 'aloo'; find_all_items('پياز') contains 'pyaaz'; find_all_items('چاہ پتی') contains 'chai_patti'; and find_all_items('mehngai zabardasti dukandar') == set() (no fabrication). In awaaz_backend/tests/test_nlp_rules.py add test_pashto_number_words: parse_word_numbers('يو سل پنځوس') contains '150'; parse_word_numbers('دوه سوه') contains '200'; parse_word_numbers('تن سو پنجاہ') contains '350'.

Strengthen the FEAT-001 Pashto end-to-end test (test_pashto_digit_chain_each_item_own_price in test_multi_item.py) to now assert the FULL 4-id set {aloo,pyaaz,tamatar,chini} resolves with prices 150/200/250/180 (aliases now present). Add test_punjabi_shahmukhi_rice_keeps_own_price: the Punjabi 5-item input ('دکاندار مرغی نو سو روپے، انڈے چار سو روپے، گھی پنج سو روپے، چاول تن سو پنجاہ روپے، چاہ پتی اک ہزار روپے وچ بیچ رہیا اے') asserts chawal_basmati reported_price == 350 (its own تن سو پنجاہ, not the tea 1000) and chai_patti is present with its own 1000.
acceptance_criteria: `.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from services.rates import rate_service; print([c for c,_ in rate_service.find_all_items('الو')], [c for c,_ in rate_service.find_all_items('پياز')], [c for c,_ in rate_service.find_all_items('چاہ پتی')])"` prints ['aloo'] ['pyaaz'] ['chai_patti'].

`.\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from services.nlp_rules import parse_word_numbers as p; print(p('يو سل پنځوس'), '|', p('دوه سوه'), '|', p('تن سو پنجاہ'))"` yields 150, 200, 350 (surrounding spaces allowed).
find_all_items('mehngai zabardasti dukandar') == set() — no phantom commodity; the existing 7-item exactly-7 no-Chicken test still passes.
Pashto 4-item example resolves all of {aloo,pyaaz,tamatar,chini} with own prices 150/200/250/180; Punjabi rice resolves to 350.
Every added non-English/Urdu spelling that is uncertain is flagged NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED (code comment where the file allows; this FEAT's findings + the plan otherwise).
verification: From awaaz_backend: `$env:DATABASE_URL=$null; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/ -q` — all pass (37 prior + new).
Alias probe: the find_all_items one-liner above prints the three expected canonical ids.
Number-word probe: the parse_word_numbers one-liner above prints 150 / 200 / 350.
findings: IMPLEMENTED. (1) services/rates.py: added module-level _normalize_script(s) folding ONLY Arabic yeh ي U+064A -> Urdu yeh ی U+06CC, alef-maksura ى U+0649 -> ی, and Arabic kaf ك U+0643 -> Urdu kaf ک U+06A9 (via _SCRIPT_FOLD_MAP). Heh variants intentionally NOT folded (greppable '# NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED: heh variants intentionally not folded' comment). Applied in load() when building every _alias_map key (id/name_en/name_ur/aliases) AND to the query text in resolve_item (normalized) and find_all_items (norm). Word-boundary regex (?<!\w)alias(?!\w) in find_all_items is UNCHANGED — folding is additive, not substring-widening; the 7-item no-Chicken invariant still holds (find_all_items('mehngai zabardasti dukandar')==set() verified). (2) rate-list.json aliases extended (valid UTF-8). aloo: +الو (آلو already present). pyaaz: +پياز (Pashto Arabic-yeh; folds to existing پیاز), +بصر [Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED]. tamatar: +رومي [Pashto], +ٽماٽا, +ٽماٽو [Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED]. chini: +بوره [Pashto], +کنڊ, +چيني [Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED]. NOTE: چيني uses Arabic yeh U+064A which _normalize_script folds to چینی — same map key as chini's existing چینی alias; harmless COLLISION (both -> chini). chicken_meat: +چرګ, +مرغ [Pashto], +ڪڪڙ [Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED] (kept whole-word; مرغ does not phantom-match مرغی because word-boundary). anday: +هګۍ [Pashto], +آنا, +بيضا [Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED]. banaspati_ghee: +غوړي [Pashto], +گيهه [Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED]. atta_kg: +اٽو [Sindhi, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED]. chai_patti: +چاہ پتی (Punjabi Shahmukhi), +چاې [Pashto, NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED]; price unchanged (SAMPLE 1600). NO new tea item created. (3) services/nlp_rules.py: BASIC_NUMBER_WORDS got Pashto يو=1 دوه=2 درې=3 څلور=4 پنځه=5 شپږ=6 اووه=7 اته=8 نهه=9 لس=10 شل=20 پنځوس=50 سل=100 سوه=100 زر=1000 زره=1000, plus Punjabi تن=3 پنجاہ=50; block carries greppable '# NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED' comments (Pashto spellings vary regionally). parse_word_numbers compound_hundreds prefix list got Pashto 1-9 (يو دوه درې څلور پنځه شپږ اووه اته نهه) and Punjabi تن=3; hundred-word loop got سوه and سل (ordered سوه BEFORE سو so 'دوه سوه' isn't half-matched by 'سو'); thousand-word loop got زره then زر (same ordering reason). Verified: parse_word_numbers('يو سل پنځوس')->'150', ('دوه سوه')->'200', ('تن سو پنجاہ')->'350'. (4) Tests: test_rates.py +test_find_all_items_resolves_pashto_sindhi_staples (الو->aloo, پياز->pyaaz, چاہ پتی->chai_patti, no fabrication). test_nlp_rules.py +test_pashto_number_words (150/200/350). test_multi_item.py: strengthened test_pashto_digit_chain_each_item_own_price to assert FULL {aloo,pyaaz,tamatar,chini} with 150/200/250/180 + Pashto language; added test_punjabi_shahmukhi_rice_keeps_own_price (chawal_basmati==350 its own تن سو پنجاہ, chai_patti==1000). DID NOT touch auth/CORS/admin-key, DB schema, routers/complaints.py under-rate filtering, or lazy whisper imports. VERIFICATION: `$env:DATABASE_URL=$null; pytest tests/ -q` -> 63 passed (Ollama live at :11434). INTEGRATION NOTES: all Sindhi forms (بصر, ٽماٽا, ٽماٽو, کنڊ, چيني, ڪڪڙ, آنا, بيضا, گيهه, اٽو) and Pashto چاې/هګۍ/غوړي/رومي/بوره left as NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED (spellings unverified by a native speaker). No aliases were dropped due to collision; the چيني->چینی fold collision is benign (same canonical id).
